original_test_intent: Read the complete access policy for an approved BMC channel and compare active/nonvolatile security state with the Project least-privilege reference.
original_method: Use the standards-based read-only Get Channel Access method selected by Project SPEC, with an approved transport, channel/selectors, field schema and policy; never borrow Set.
manual_activity: Engineer decides whether the standard 0x06/0x41 read and which active/nonvolatile selector coverage apply to this identity, then approves channel/policy scope.
safety_requirements: No guessed read while source TBD

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly blocks the literal TBD; related standard 0x41 evidence is a candidate Review method, not authorization to fill Master silently.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, use the exact App 0x06/0x41 channel/selector form with field parser and no setters.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select a Project transport/channel and active/nonvolatile selector matrix, run standard read-only App 0x06/0x41, decode all masks/reserved bits and compare with policy/effective access.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a standards-based Review method while preserving the Master TBD.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Claim only the selected transport and selector matrix.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Mis-scoped security state can hide unauthorized privilege or drive unsafe later writes.

project_override_considerations: Standard OOB/IB wrappers may be approved only with recorded transport and equivalent fields; Set Channel Access is never equivalent.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title maps to a known security read, but Master supplies no procedure, transport, selector or criteria and instructs clearing audit evidence; the Review method must preserve this gap.

blocked_analysis.analysis: App 0x06/0x41 defines the core read; transport, channel/selectors, parser and policy are Project readiness inputs, not an irreducible semantic contradiction.

review_improvement: Uses historical 0x41 evidence to avoid permanently blocking a defined read while preserving every unspecified coverage dimension.
independent_technical_reasoning: The standard read-only operation fixes the core semantics. Project SPEC may select transport, channel matrix and governing active/nonvolatile state; those choices affect coverage but do not prevent static review or packaged automation, so REQUIRES PACKAGE is more accurate than BLOCKED.
